method: As plan70-FPS-pieces.json: a page-side counter in the Quick Access page copies requestAnimationFrame timestamps and every 2.5 s logs frames a second over the last 2.2 s (first 0.3 s of the slice dropped). At each slice end it also logs whether the live answer preview ([data-bonsai-stream-preview]) is present, its letters, the Stop button, and the letters of the last answer bubble. 'arriving' = preview present at both ends of the slice and its letters grew; 'edge' = preview at one end only; 'tail' = preview present at the start only. The counter was started in the page before each question; A pressed on Ask only after reading focus on the Ask button and the open chat's name. A repeated-question cache hit was avoided: all six questions are worded differently.
pressed: Per answer: send-question script (VERIFIED each time), walk Down to Ask, read focus, A. Plugin opened with deck_openPlugin.
